content:
Anika Patel: Heads-up — I noticed an ambiguity in the docs around the /generate param name. Some examples use `response_format` and some use `output_format`. This will confuse SDK users during migration.
Sam Chen: oof, yeah saw that in a snippet earlier. Which one matches the SDK surface?
Leo Martín: SDK bindings currently accept `response_format` (legacy) and we added `output_format` as an alias in v0.9.0 for parity with internal API. Both work but docs shouldn't show both.
Maya Singh: My vote is to pick one canonical public name and show the other as deprecated alias. Prefer `output_format` for plain language.
Anika Patel: +1 to a single canonical name. We should: 1) pick canonical, 2) update examples, 3) add migration note in the upgrade guide, 4) add glossary entry describing alias.
Sam Chen: technically `output_format` maps 1:1 to the new router naming we use in redwood-runtime, so that makes sense. If we go with `output_format` we should add a 1-line deprecation callout for `response_format`.
Leo Martín: I'll open a tiny SDK PR to keep `response_format` as alias and mark it deprecated in the docstring. Will add link back to docs.
Anika Patel: Thanks Leo. I'll update the docs examples and the quick migration snippet. Putting the snippet here for review — please ✋ if this looks good: 
```
# Before (older SDKs)
resp = client.generate(model='x', response_format='json')
# After (canonical)
resp = client.generate(model='x', output_format='json')
```
Maya Singh: looks clean. Add a note about tokenization differences for structured outputs? Some customers expect strict JSON and we should mention `validate_json=true` example.
Anika Patel: good call. new snippet with validate flag: 
```
resp = client.generate(model='x', output_format='json', validate_json=True)
```
Sam Chen: can we also add a single-line redirect in the older docs page so old links still land on the canonical page?
Anika Patel: yes — I can add a meta redirect and an HTML fallback for the static site.
Anika Patel: proposed doc tasks: 
- update canonical param to `output_format` in all REST + SDK examples :zap:
- add deprecation callout for `response_format` :warning:
- add migration snippet in /docs/migration/v0.9 -> assigned to @Anika by EOW
- add glossary entry for "output format / response format" -> assigned to @Maya
- SDK alias PR -> assigned to @Leo
- add redirect on old page -> assigned to @Sam
Sam Chen: I can do the redirect and coordinate with infra for a quick deploy. ETA Wed.
Leo Martín: opening SDK PR now, linking this thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/834 :eyes:
docs-bot: linter notice — docs/style: prefer `output_format` (rule: param-naming). Files flagged: docs/guides/generate.md: lines 42, 89
Maya Singh: I'll draft the glossary text and push to the docs repo as a tiny PR, then ping here for review.
Anika Patel: cool. One more micro question — should the glossary entry include both param names and a short sentence about runtime fallback? e.g., "output_format (preferred) — `response_format` accepted as alias until 2026-09-01"
Sam Chen: include the date and a note that SDK will log a deprecation warning. Good for customers.
Anika Patel: ok final checklist before I push: update examples (done locally), add migration snippet (just wrote it), glossary PR draft by Maya, SDK PR link from Leo, redirect from Sam. I'll push my docs PR in ~30m and tag all of you.
Leo Martín: thanks — will add deprecation warning in SDK and include a short test.
Maya Singh: sending draft in 1hr for quick review.
Anika Patel: thanks team :party_parrot: — closing this thread once PRs are linked.
Sam Chen: :thumbsup:
docs-bot: deployment scheduled for 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC (staging), will run smoke tests.
